draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.80, the 216th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 31st of 32 at WR. He went 177th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (216th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (14th percentile), 20-yard shuttle (20th percentile). College production: 625 receiving yards in 2022, 23rd of 32 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Los Angeles Rams. 44 career games and 43 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 2 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (18 AV) was his best yet. Strengths in 2025: approximate value 18 (100th percentile), receiving yards 1,715 (99th percentile), team target share 28.6% (98th percentile). Versus the typical Year-3 wide receiver who played: 1,715 receiving yards against a median of 346, above the norm.
